a.speaker: anchor
a.text: Good evening. Barstow police are investigating a mass killing at the Sunset Palms Motel late last night.

b.speaker: anchor
b.text: Authorities have confirmed twenty-four dead. Investigators also found a gold star painted on the wall of room 204.

c1.speaker: anchor
c1.text: Night manager Lyle Harcourt survived and was taken into custody for questioning. He has refused to identify the attacker.

c2.speaker: anchor
c2.text: Among the dead is night manager Lyle Harcourt, whose employment records connect him to a film production shut down last year after a fatal stunt accident.

d.speaker: anchor
d.text: One long-term resident agreed to speak with Channel 9.

e1.speaker: earl
e1.text: She told me to stay inside. Didn't ask my name, didn't ask for money. Just said lock the door.

e2.speaker: anchor
e2.text: The resident scheduled to speak with us was later identified among the dead.

f.speaker: anchor
f.text: And in entertainment news, KHSC has acquired a mysterious new late-night program titled HOTSHOT CALIFORNIA.

g.speaker: marv
g.text: California, keep your eyes open. Our leading lady doesn't know the cameras are still rolling.
